result.official_quote: The landlord shall perform the acts described in this section within 15 days of service of a written notice of termination described in California Civil Code Section 1946.
result.condition: You are not owed relocation assistance under the Just Cause Ordinance if the Housing Department finds your unit became unsafe because of a fire, flood, earthquake or other event the owner did not cause or contribute to, or if you are a resident manager being replaced by a new manager in the same unit.
result.condition_quote: The Department determines that the unit or structure became unsafe or hazardous as the result of a fire, flood, earthquake, or other event beyond the control of the owner or the designated agent and the owner or designated agent did not cause or contribute to the condition.
result.note: Replaced the 'LAMC' shorthand and nickname-only forms with house-style 'L.A. Mun. Code' cites naming Ord. No. 187737 (which added the JCO, per O090) and Ord.
